plan.summary: BRO-5602: two closed shows were labelled Fizzle (an estimated 30% or more returned) although every estimate on their own records says under 30%: Suffs and Call Me Izzy become Flop; the uncited 0-10% Suffs range and its notes sentence go.
steps: Each edit reads its oldValue from live commercial.json.

actions.description: suffs: the loss rests on a cited report (recoupedSource: The New York Times via Fox News, Oct 13 2024, "it has not recouped that amount"), not on our notes; listed before the designation edit.
suffs: Fizzle means an estimated 30% or more returned; every estimate on the record is under that (model 4-42%, middle 23%), so Flop.
suffs: the 0-10% returned range came from an AI research summary ("GPT DR") with no source; an uncited line is not an estimate we can show.

actions.oldValue: Won Tony for Best Original Score but closed Jan 5, 2025 without recouping. Shaina Taub won two Tonys. Weekly nut ~$640K (breakeven ~$800K gross). Cast of 19. Often grossed only $500-700K in summer/fall (below nut), only hit capacity in final holiday weeks. Hillary Clinton and Malala Yousafzai co-producers. Frequently comped tickets to build word-of-mouth. SEC entities: 'Young Are At the Gates LLC' ($19M, main Broadway) + 'Wing Women On Broadway LLC' ($6.75M, development). Nearly total loss for investors (0-10% returned).
